integrity: The proof is analytic and finite-group exact. The standalone verifier checks representative difference sets with exact rational arithmetic; those finite checks corroborate but do not replace the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Assumes an exact finite abelian difference set. The intrinsic equality criterion is complete, but it is not simplified to character restrictions for every difference set and no higher-moment claim is made.
title: Sharp fourth-moment extension and exact deficit for finite abelian difference sets
